fields.statement: Change set 01M6QBS (web UI host setting) serves no intent yet, and milestone 28's done point m28-read-only says the UI 'binds only to 127.0.0.1', which this change contradicts. What should it serve, and what happens to that done point? / Which values should rhiza daemon set rhiza.web.host accept? / How should the existing landed leaves web-serve-loopback (asserts always 127.0.0.1) and web-url-in-daemon-status (shows http://127.0.0.1:<port>) be handled?
